ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Limited and several key directors, including Mr. Gautam S. Adani, have reached a settlement with SEBI regarding alleged violations of Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) norms and related disclosure regulations. The company paid a non-material settlement amount of INR 37,05,000 without admitting or denying the findings, closing proceedings that indicate past regulatory scrutiny concerning compliance with significant shareholding rules.
